title: Sequential OR tree correctness
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $x$ assign a sign in $\{ -1,1 \}$ to each of its $n$ coordinates. The decision tree that queries the coordinates in increasing order, returns $-1$ as soon as it finds a coordinate with value $-1$, and returns $1$ if every coordinate has value $1$ computes the function that is $1$ exactly when every coordinate has value $1$, and is $-1$ otherwise.
